handoff.purpose: Defines project_scope() and effective_rules() with docstrings describing precedence and composition.

symbols.name: project_scope
symbols.note: Resolves ProjectScope for root. Accepts optional center and extra_ignore.

symbols.name: effective_rules
symbols.note: Combines file rules with DAEDALUS_IGNORE env var.

claims.text: ``center`` precedence: explicit argument (project config / CLI flag) over ``DAEDALUS_CENTER``.
claims.why: The function uses _norm_center(center) if center else env_center(). This shows explicit argument over env_center(), but env_center() is not defined in this chunk; its source (DAEDALUS_CENTER) is uncheckable.

claims.text: Ignore rules compose in a fixed order -- center says which tree is yours, ignore carves exceptions *within* it: .daedalusignore  ->  DAEDALUS_IGNORE  ->  extra_ignore (project config). Later wins, because ``matches()`` is last-match-wins.
claims.why: The order .daedalusignore -> DAEDALUS_IGNORE -> extra_ignore is consistent with the code: load_ignore_rules (file) + env_extra_patterns (env) + extra_ignore (argument). However, 'last-match-wins' depends on matches() which is not in this chunk.

claims.text: That ordering lets a project config re-include something the repo file excluded (``!path``), which is the only way a shared repo file and a per-project override can coexist.
claims.why: The claim about re-inclusion via !path depends on matches() behavior not shown.

claims.text: File rules plus ``DAEDALUS_IGNORE``, in that order (env wins on tie).
claims.why: The code combines base.rules + parsed (env after file). 'env wins on tie' implies last-match-wins, which depends on matches() not in chunk.

observations.what: project_scope() composes rules in order: file, env, extra_ignore. It creates a new IgnoreRules with concatenated rules list.
effective_rules() combines file rules with env patterns, preserving order (file then env).
Both functions compute a fingerprint by concatenating fingerprints and patterns with '|'.
Docstring claims about environment variable names (DAEDALUS_CENTER, DAEDALUS_IGNORE) cannot be verified from this chunk alone.
